payload.blocks: Phase 7 and the done status of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner.
payload.headline: Widen heads plan footprint by 5 stale test and record files so phase 7 can fix 7 cargo failures

parts.cause: Phases 2 and 6 changed the request frame, the grant source, the release keys and the verb list without updating those records, and five of the files lie outside the plan footprint, so the lead cannot land a fix: apps/fgos/tests/supervision_verbs.rs, apps/fgos/tests/questions_head.rs, packages/config/contracts/fixtures/authoring-source.config.json, packages/component-authority/model/contracts.yaml, test/rust-host/vectors/envelope/version.json. The doc-line fix (core/config-standard/release.yaml) is already in the footprint.

options.cost: One fix unit (about 20 minutes) plus one suite rerun.
options.does: The planner or supervisor adds the 5 paths to the plan footprint; the lead runs one fix unit in a phase-7 worktree (tests assert the fgos argv frame, the negative control uses a table deny, vector regenerated with generate-vectors.mjs, fixture and authority row added, release doc line rendered from its schema), reviews and lands it; the owner then reruns the two suites unconfined, one after the other.
options.gain: Phase 7 closes with the 7 failures owned and fixed by the plan that caused them.
options.harm: The plan footprint grows by 5 files; one more unconfined suite run.
options.label: Widen the footprint by the 5 files

options.does: Phase 7 records the 7 failures as known and closes; a new item fixes them.
options.harm: Acceptance criterion 2 (both suites green) is not met and main stays red on this plan's failures.
options.label: Hand the fixes to a new backlog item

parts.recommendation: Widen the footprint by the 5 files: the failures are this plan's own debt, and acceptance criterion 2 needs them fixed.

scope.allows: Adding exactly those 5 paths to the plan footprint and one fix unit that changes them plus core/config-standard/release.yaml.
scope.forbids: Touching the other 17 npm failures and the holder-lock load-sensitive test, which belong to other owners.

parts.what: On release 33f462be, cargo test --workspace fails 8 tests; 7 come from this plan (supervisor report plans/reports/supervisor-261125-1838-npm-test-24-failures-on-main.md). They are stale tests and records, not product bugs: supervision_verbs.rs and questions_head.rs assert the retired typed request and envelope verbs list; the authoring fixture lacks release.* standard-only paths; contracts.yaml lacks the declared head-permissions.v1.json row; the version.json vector lacks can-i (likely also the 3 npm envelope-contract failures).
